launcher.noSubfolders: No subfolders — you can start here.
launcher.help.title: New session
launcher.help.intro: New session is the doorway for starting work. You can open a Chat, Claude in a terminal, a regular terminal, or a neutral Aduana Room, and the console leaves the new session ready to use.
launcher.help.first.title: First steps
launcher.help.first.step2: Choose Chat, Claude TUI, Terminal, or 🛃 Room depending on how you want to work.
launcher.help.first.step3: For Chat, Claude TUI, or Terminal, choose Tolkien, Mi Consola (or My space), or Other folder. Room does not ask for a destination.
launcher.help.first.step4: When applicable, choose the model Claude will use; a regular Terminal does not show this selector.
launcher.help.first.step5: Tap “Start in…” to create and open the session.

launcher.help.actions.title: Buttons and actions
launcher.help.actions.open.v: Opens the launcher; it does not create processes or consume tokens yet.
launcher.help.actions.chat.v: Creates a conversation with history, permissions, and tools. It consumes tokens when you send a message.
launcher.help.actions.tui.v: Starts Claude Code inside tmux. Requests you type there consume tokens.
launcher.help.actions.terminal.v: Opens a shell without a model or AI runner; commands run directly on the server.
launcher.help.actions.sala.v: Creates a neutral Aduana Chat without choosing a folder. Messages you send and their responses consume tokens.
launcher.help.actions.console.v: Selects the canonical console project folder for the host and admins.
launcher.help.actions.mySpace.v: Selects the user's isolated space when signed in as a non-admin tenant.
launcher.help.actions.other.v: Lets you browse directories; the folder you are viewing becomes selected.
launcher.help.actions.back.v: Leaves the browser and returns to the known destinations.
launcher.help.actions.breadcrumb.v: Tap a path level to go back or a folder to enter and select it.
launcher.help.actions.model.v: Chooses the model for Chat, Claude TUI, or Room. The options change by type, and the selector is not shown for a regular Terminal.
launcher.help.actions.start.v: Creates and focuses the session; it becomes enabled after you choose a destination.
launcher.help.actions.help.v: Opens this help without closing the launcher.
launcher.help.actions.close.v: Closes the launcher and discards the current selection.
launcher.help.destinations.title: Destinations and folders
launcher.help.destinations.text: The current list does not show recent folders: it offers Tolkien, your own place (Mi Consola or My space), and Other folder. In the browser, the folder you are viewing becomes selected; you can start there even if it has no subfolders.
launcher.help.permissions.title: Chat permission mode
launcher.help.permissions.intro: The current launcher does not show this selector: Chat starts in “Everything” and you can change it from the conversation header.
launcher.help.permissions.ask.v: Requests confirmation before using sensitive tools; this is the controlled option.
launcher.help.permissions.edits.v: Accepts file edits with fewer interruptions; review the request's scope.
launcher.help.permissions.all.v: Accepts every tool without asking; this is the highest-risk mode.
launcher.help.permissions.plan.v: Allows reasoning and proposals without executing changes.
launcher.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
launcher.help.warning.text: The current launcher creates Chats and Claude TUI sessions in “Everything” mode: they can run tools or commands without asking for permission. In Chat, you can change the mode from the header as soon as it opens; in Claude TUI, review every instruction before sending it.
